skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand main ideas and take notes on short dialogues and monologues in academic contexts.
Communicate effectively on a range of topics, using appropriate vocabulary and grammar structures.
Comprehend main ideas and extract specific details from texts, understand context.
Construct sentences and paragraphs, develop arguments and present ideas coherently.
Improve overall English proficiency for academic and professional contexts.
Prepare for IELTS exams, focusing on listening, speaking, reading, and writing skills.
Analyze and evaluate information from texts and discussions.
Participate in group discussions and collaborative activities.
Manage time effectively to complete assignments and prepare for exams.
